step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claimant’s reports have been processed up to and including the last week of the WS agreement:

ul.li: If no, go to step 26.
If yes, go to step 35.

step.cmd: Determine if there are cycling claimant’s reports up to and including the last week of the WS agreement:

ul.li: If no, go to step 27.
If yes, go to step 31.

step.cmd: Determine if any details are required for claimant’s reports for the WS period. Refer to Claimant’s report for more information:

ul.li: If fact-finding is required, fact-find with the client and go to step 28. fact-find
If fact-finding is not required, go to step 30.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 29.
If the client was not contacted and did not reply to the N-10-00-00, the week in which the separation occurs is processed as the last week of WS benefits. Go to step 35.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Separation from WS employer during WS agreement.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding, Documentation and Retention Policy . National Fact-Finding, Documentation and Retention Policy
Click Save.

step.cmd: Refer to Inputting a claimant’s report to input the claimant’s reports up to and including the last week of the WS agreement. Do not include STUAE coding (so the claimant’s reports can cycle). Go to step 31.
Determine if there are URs for the period up to and including the last week to be processed as WS benefits:

ul.li: If no, go to step 32.
If yes, go to step 35.

step.cmd: In NWS, create an IPOC REV WI as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate language.

Destination — SCC: Select the IPOC based on the region in which the claim is located in FTS:
Atlantic: Select 1826 Moncton IPOC .
Ontario: Select 3056 Belleville IPOC .
Quebec: Select 2642 Montreal IPOC (3) .
Western Canada and Territories: Select 5903 Vancouver IPOC .
End User: Select Next available user .
Issue: Select Work-Sharing .
BPC: Type the BPC of the claim.
Comments: Type “WS – RFS adjudicated – WS end week is correct.”
Details: Type “Client is requesting WS benefits for w/c [XXXX].” Type SIN, WS agreement number, client's name and WS end week.
Obtained by: Select the appropriate method.
Obtained from: Select the appropriate source.
Source details: Enter the source details.
Click Save .

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Awaiting processing of last WS claimant’s reports.”

Bring forward date: Enter the appropriate date:
If the UR is on file, enter today’s date + 1 day.
If the UR is not on file, enter today’s date + 2 days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the claimant’s reports have been processed:

ul.li: If no, repeat step 32.
If yes, go to step 35.

step.cmd: Determine if a renewal or conversion from WS benefits is required:

ul.li: If no, go to step 36.
If yes, return to the appropriate Conversion and renewal task. Conversion and renewal
